sites.name: Nasca Lines (lookout tower and natural lookout)
sites.era: ancient (era not stated in the tariff annex)
sites.what: Geoglyphs on the Nasca plain, seen from two ground lookouts or by air.

access.tickets: Lookout tower: S/6 general, S/2 higher-education students, S/1 minors. Natural lookout: S/3 general, S/2 students, S/1 minors. Partial aerial circuit tourist ticket: S/47 for national and foreign tourists (in force since 31 January 2022). 50% off for over-60s, teachers, people with disability and volunteer military. (No RBA rate for PEN; at the Banco Central de Reserva del Perú rate of 30 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 2.4408 PEN: S/6 ≈ A$2.46; S/2 ≈ A$0.82; S/1 ≈ A$0.41; S/3 ≈ A$1.23; S/47 ≈ A$19.26)
access.permits: Flight operators sell the overflight itself; the S/47 is the circuit ticket.

lore.text: Popular theories claim the lines were landing strips or signals meant for visitors from the sky.
lore.label: popular lore, not an official source

sites.name: Paracas necropolis and Julio C. Tello site museum
sites.era: ancient (era not stated in the tariff annex)

access.tickets: S/7.50 general, S/4 students, S/1 minors; covers monument and museum. (No RBA rate for PEN; at the Banco Central de Reserva del Perú rate of 30 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 2.4408 PEN: S/7.50 ≈ A$3.07; S/4 ≈ A$1.64; S/1 ≈ A$0.41)

layers.authority: SERNANP (Servicio Nacional de Areas Naturales Protegidas por el Estado)
layers.process: Paracas National Reserve and the Islas Ballestas: the single tariff (tarifa unica) that applies to visitors who are not Peruvian residents is S/ 40 for 1 day (about A$16.39), S/ 60 for 2 to 3 days (A$24.58) and S/ 120 for 4 to 30 days (A$49.16), in tariff group III. Under-5s, people with disability and tourist guides enter free. The lower special tariff is for nationals and resident foreigners only. The head of each area can set promotional rates. A$ about: S/ 1 = A$0.41 (PEN 3.467 per USD, central-bank-rates.json 30 Oct 2026, with RBA A$1 = USD 0.7040).
